segments.sn35.139:1.2: Taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati.
segments.sn35.139:1.5: te pajahatha. Te vo pahīnā hitāya sukhāya bhavissanti.
segments.sn35.139:1.6: Saddā … gandhā … rasā … phoṭṭhabbā … dhammā na tumhākaṃ;
segments.sn35.139:1.11: Te vo pahīnā hitāya sukhāya bhavissanti.
segments.sn35.139:1.12: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, yaṃ imasmiṃ jetavane … pe … evameva kho, bhikkhave, rūpā na tumhākaṃ;
segments.sn35.139:1.14: Te vo pahīnā hitāya sukhāya bhavissantī”ti.
